newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Freight to complete spin-off.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Freight to complete spin-off.

text.p: Consolidated Freightways Inc. said it would complete the previously announced spin-off of its long-haul trucking company and its Canadian subsidiaries to shareholders Monday, saying its operations were increasingly competing with each other.

The new company, Consolidated Freightways Corp., will include long-haul carrier CF Motorfreight, Canadian Freightways Ltd. and other Canadian operations. The businesses' annual revenues total about $2.1 billion.

The original company, with annual revenues of about $3.6 billion, is changing its name to CNF Transportation. CNF's businesses include air and ocean freight company Emery Worldwide; Con-Way Transportation Services; trailer maker Road Systems Inc.; and truck parts and supplies distributor VantageParts.
The spun-off company will be listed on Nasdaq under the symbol CFWY. CNF Transportation will retain the CNF ticker symbol and listing on the New York Stock Exchange.

Consolidated reiterated its rationale for the spin-off announced Aug. 26 that industry changes and shifts in distribution patterns increasingly put the company's long-haul and regional trucking companies in competition with each other.
Consolidated Freightways stock rose 25 cents to $24.325 in afternoon trading.
